integrity: Every one of 65536 sensor subsets of each graph was checked independently by ordered-partition and pairwise-comparison programs. Exchange distances checked from every minimum basis; coefficients and all output quantities reproduced by both programs.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite results only for two labelled 16-vertex graphs; unknown coverage in unindexed historical computations; no all-order family generalization and no external independent audit.
title: Centroidal sensing polynomials and exact optimal exchanges distinguish the Shrikhande and rook graphs
